parameters.query:
-- Datos del panel de supervisión (solo lectura): vendedores + consultas de los últimos 30 días
with fb as (
  select distinct on (chat_log_id) chat_log_id, calificacion, comentario
  from feedback
  where chat_log_id is not null
  order by chat_log_id, id desc
)
select
  (select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
      'id', u.telegram_chat_id::text, 'n', u.nombre, 'a', u.area, 'e', u.estado)), '[]'::json)
   from jerigo_usuarios u
   where u.telegram_chat_id is not null and coalesce(u.canal, 'Telegram') = 'Telegram'
  ) as usuarios,
  (select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
      's', c.session_id, 't', floor(extract(epoch from c.fecha) * 1000),
      'p', c.pregunta, 'r', c.respuesta, 'c', fb.calificacion, 'm', fb.comentario
    ) order by c.fecha desc), '[]'::json)
   from chat_logs c
   left join fb on fb.chat_log_id = c.id
   where c.fecha >= now() - interval '30 days'
  ) as consultas;
